# Learnwith

> Learnwith is an interactive learning site by Abhijeet Kakade. It currently has introductory lessons on system design and Avalanche blockchain.

- [Home](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/): Choose an interactive technology lesson.
- [System Design](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/learn/system-design/): Keep a ticket website working during a traffic surge, then practise explaining the design.
- [Avalanche Blockchain](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/learn/avalanche/): Sign and send a simplified transaction to see what wallets, networks, and validators do.

Lessons are introductory and interactive. The site is free to explore without an account.
